source_text.body:
Turn inbox, calendar and Drive into a daily action list
A reviewer connected a Dots agent to Gmail, Calendar and Drive; it produced one action list and daily summary, with read-only rules it wrote itself.
Done with
DO
Dots
What they did
Tim Moylan set up a Dots agent with Gmail, Google Calendar and Drive connected, then asked it to get him ready for tomorrow. It went through the calendar, emails he had promised to act on or never answered, and Drive files where he was tagged. It merged these into one list, then created an 8am daily scheduled task with its own read-only brief.
How it went
He got one action list that caught emails he had forgotten to answer. The agent also wrote its own rules: verify newer replies, separate fact from guesswork, and never message anyone or change the calendar.
Worth knowing
Dots comes with Pro, but the $200 plan's limits were halved, and the extended launch limits end around October's close. The author suggests judging it in November. A Take over button lets you watch the agent.
Try it yourself
with
Dots
Copy prompt
Connect to my Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive with read-only access, and write down the rules you will follow so you never send, delete, or edit anything. Then go through my unread email, this week's calendar, and recently changed files in [Drive folder or project names] and give me one prioritized action list for today with the source of each item. Set it up to send me the same summary every [weekday morning at 8am], and stop once I've approved the first list.
Original source: https://www.beyondthebuzz.ai/p/openai-dots
